name: Structural Superlubricity
description: A van der Waals calculator for twisted graphene: the total interaction energy of a real atomistic flake on a graphene sheet, summed pair by pair, with a Hamaker continuum tail for what a finite window misses. Relax the offset and the interlayer spacing, sweep the twist angle or slide the flake, and run lateral MD to watch the moire reconstruct into commensurate domains.
